name: autofix-inline-comments
description: While Auto-fix is on for the session's PR, hands Claude the PR's unresolved inline review threads that Auto-fix did not deliver, and signs every PR comment Claude posts from your account so the two can be told apart.

pollMinutes.title: Poll interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to check the PR for new inline review comments while Auto-fix is on.

ignoreAuthors.title: Ignored authors
ignoreAuthors.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins whose threads are never surfaced (a [bot] suffix is optional).
